history.content: Linear vs Shortcut for a 6-person eng team — pick one and tell me why.

Linear. For a 6 person eng team it's not close. Why: Speed and craft. Linear is fast, keyboard first, and opinionated. A small team benefits from strong defaults instead of configuring a tool into shape. Cycles and roadmaps built in. You get sprint planning, triage, and roadmap views out of the box, no setup tax. GitHub/GitHub PR integration is tight, issues auto update from PRs, which is most of what a 6 person team actually needs from a tracker. When Shortcut wins instead: if your team mixes eng with non eng folks (design, marketing) who want a friendlier kanban board, or you hate Linear's opinionated workflow. Shortcut is more flexible, more casual. But at 6 engineers, opinionated and fast beats flexible and loose. Go Linear.
